_comment: Character quips (DEVELOPMENT_PLAN Step 15 scope 6). Original lines. Categories are fired by QuipDirector with per-category cooldowns and priorities; one line is picked at random without immediate repeats. Recorded takes go to content/audio/vo/quip_<character>_<category>_<index>.ogg.

box_wonder: Oh, now that is a breakthrough.
Science, at last, on our side!
box_good: A sensible choice, given the circumstances.
box_bad: The box has a sense of humour. Dreadful one.
perk: Delightful. I can feel my pupils.
low_ammo: I appear to be running out of argument.
downed: I'm afraid I've had a small collapse!
Help! Clinically speaking, this is bad!
powerup: A gift from the mountain. How ominous.

box_wonder: Ja! Now we climb out of this.
box_bad: Useless. Like a rope with no anchor.
revived: Thanks. I owe you a rope.
powerup: Take it, before the snow does.

downed: I'm hit — somebody earn their pay!
revived: Appreciated. Don't make it a habit.
revive_given: You're not getting out of this that easy.
powerup: Gift horse. Check its teeth later.

box_wonder: I built the heart of this. Now I hold it.
God forgive me, I like this.
box_bad: The box hates me. I knew.
downed: Help! This is not my day!
revived: I am back. Do not tell my mother.
revive_given: Up, up! The dead do not rest here.
multi_kill: The reactor feeds you no more.
